title: Unary append block
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a,N\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be a finite word over the schedule alphabet. For any base configuration on $x$, input-head position $p$, integers $b,g$, and tape contents $\beta,\gamma\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\text{Option}(\text{OblSymbol})$, start the schedule machine in phase $\mathsf{append}(0)$ with its binary-budget head at $b$, unary-counter head at $N+1$ over the tape with $N$ unary markers, and guide head at $g$; let its clock tapes and output be those of the base configuration. After $a+2$ steps, the configuration has phase $\mathsf{borrow}(\mathsf{true})$, the same input-head position, clock tapes, budget tape and head, guide tape and head, and output; its unary-counter tape has $N+a+1$ markers and its head is at $N+(a+1)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$x$ is a finite word over the schedule alphabet
input-head position $p$ among the valid positions
binary-budget head position $b$ and guide head position $g$ are integers
binary-budget tape contents $\beta$ and guide tape contents $\gamma$ are arbitrary functions from integers to optional schedule symbols
replaced:
From a setup configuration in append phase $0$ with unary head at cell $N+1$ over the
unary tape with $N$ markers, exactly $a+2$ steps append exactly $a+1$ unit markers and
enter the borrow phase with incoming borrow set: the unary head is then at cell
$N+(a+1)+1$ over the unary tape with $N+a+1$ markers, and all other tapes and heads are
unchanged.
